supplements.note: the precondition owner ruling stays byte-identical; this record narrows only the concurrency SCOPE used by its residual quiet gate and in-item monitoring

priorInterpretation: machine-wide: any vitest / npm test / npm validate shaped process in any repository disqualified the quiet gate

correctedScope.blockingDefinition: a process blocks the Window-09 quiet gate or in-item exclusivity only if it can affect the correctness boundary of this Engine task
blockingCriteria: its cwd is inside the NWF Partnership Engine repository or any of its worktrees
it reads or writes Engine task artifacts in a correctness-critical way
it starts an Engine acquisition, evaluation, validation or other Engine correctness-critical command
it accesses or mutates the live acquisition database nwf_pe outside the governed Window-09 execution
it is a descendant or ancestor of another competing Engine correctness-critical process
it otherwise demonstrably shares mutable state on which this Window-09 live execution depends

knownIsolatedExternalActivity.identity: npm test / vitest process trees whose cwd is the worktree wt-dutch-v2-db-impl of the separate NewWave Fluent application repository (git common dir newwavefluent/.git), launched by a separate interactive Claude session
isolationConditionsCheckedEveryPoll: cwd inside that worktree and outside every Engine repository/worktree path
command references no Engine repository/worktree path
same-snapshot process chain contains no Engine correctness-critical process
no open TCP connection to the local Engine PostgreSQL listener (127.0.0.1:55432, which serves nwf_pe)
knownIsolatedExternalActivity.ifAnyIsolationConditionFails: the process is counted as competing (fail closed)

operationalApplication.where: the local Window-09 operator watcher only (gitignored kit); no generic concurrency code, gate adapter or architecture change
operationalApplication.watcherSelfTestExtendedWith: an isolated-shaped probe in that worktree must classify KNOWN_ISOLATED_EXTERNAL_ACTIVITY and not count, while governed/orphan/external probes keep their prior verdicts

priorBlockerIntervention: before this clarification, under an owner authorisation limited to the blocker TEST tree, SIGTERM was sent to one npm test / vitest run in that worktree; it exited and the separate session relaunched a new run about 8 s later; the separate session itself was never signalled; no further intervention is authorised
